title: Excellent Non-Stick Heavy Biscotti Pan
text: Excellent Non-Stick Heavy Biscotti Pan. Used this biscotti pan for the first time today.  I am very, very impressed!  It worked perfectly.  It's nice and heavy (for good heat retention).  Was truly non-stick (although I did lightly butter just in case).  I would recommend this baking pan highly.  It's the perfect size for biscotti too.

product_metadata.title: USA Pan Bakeware Aluminized Steel Biscotti Pan
features: USA Pan Biscotti pan is the perfect pan to make crunchy authentic biscotti cookies
Unique corrugated surface design facilitates air circulation for evenly baked goods and quick release
BIscotti pan is finished with USA Pan’s proprietary silicone nonstick Americoat coating which allows for superior baking, easy release and quick clean up; PFAS, PTFE, PFOA and BPA free
Made from Aluminized steel; a mix of steel for strength and durability and aluminum for superior heat conductivity
USA Pan is a Bundy family company that has proudly manufactured high quality bakeware and provided jobs in the USA for over 60 years
description: The USA Pan biscotti pan measures a full 12 x 5.5 x 2 inches and makes authentic Italian cookies with an amazingly easy release. This pan allows you to make one of a kind homemade treats for your friends and family. The biscotti pan surface is coated with Americoat, a proprietary nonstick silicone, allowing easy removal of Italian cookies from the pan. The nonstick feature makes clean up truly effortless. Every USA Pan is designed with standard features that commercial bakers enjoy, including aluminized steel construction with steel wires providing extra strength and reduces potential warping. All pan metal thickness has been carefully selected to allow even heat flow that distributes evenly baked goods for high performance baking. USA Pan is a Bundy family company, based in the greater Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania area that has been producing high quality bake ware for over 60 years.
